reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a vertical battery with a low charge level. It fits everyday tasks about buying, charging, testing, or recycling household batteries, device batteries, and power banks. It is only slightly less distinctive than a full battery set because many battery level variants exist, and at very small sizes its silhouette loosely resembles a bottle.
